item.fists.name: Flip-Flop Fists
item.fists.desc: Fists. Always on you. Slappy, but it counts.
item.pistol.name: Conch Pistol
item.pistol.desc: Pistol. Pocket-sized, reliable, a bit squeaky. Uses Pebbles.
item.smg.name: Spritzer SMG
item.smg.desc: SMG. Sprays fast, like a sprinkler with opinions. Uses Pebbles.
item.shotgun.name: Scatter Clam
item.shotgun.desc: Shotgun. Snaps open, sprays shot. Brutal up close. Uses Seashells.
item.rifle.name: Longshore Rifle
item.rifle.desc: Rifle. Hard-hitting and accurate at range. Uses Coral.
item.ammo_light.name: Pebbles
item.ammo_light.desc: Light ammo for the Conch Pistol and Spritzer SMG.
item.ammo_heavy.name: Coral
item.ammo_heavy.desc: Heavy ammo for the Longshore Rifle, Driftwood DMR, Breakwater LMG and Sand Dollar Revolver.
item.ammo_shell.name: Seashells
item.ammo_shell.desc: Shells for the Scatter Clam and Double Scoop Shotgun. Yes, really.
item.bandage.name: Aloe Wrap
item.bandage.desc: Bandage. Quick, cool relief for small ouches.
item.medkit.name: Cooler Kit
item.medkit.desc: Medkit. A picnic cooler full of patch-ups. Heals a lot, slowly.
item.dmr.name: Driftwood DMR
item.dmr.desc: DMR. Semi-auto with a 4x scope. Steady at range. Uses Coral.
item.sniper.name: Lighthouse Sniper
item.sniper.desc: Sniper. Bolt-action with an 8x scope. One headshot ends most holidays. Uses Pearls.
item.lmg.name: Breakwater LMG
item.lmg.desc: LMG. A huge mag that sprays and sprays. Slow to reload, heavy to lug. Uses Coral.
item.ammo_sniper.name: Pearls
item.ammo_sniper.desc: Sniper ammo for the Lighthouse Sniper. Rare and shiny.
item.vest_1.name: Puffer Vest
item.vest_1.desc: Vest, Lv.1. Inflatable and surprisingly tough. Soaks up body hits and blasts.
item.vest_2.name: Lifeguard Vest
item.vest_2.desc: Vest, Lv.2. Bright red and well padded. Soaks up more body hits and blasts.
item.vest_3.name: Shellback Vest
item.vest_3.desc: Vest, Lv.3. Tortoise-tough plates. Soaks up even more body hits and blasts.
item.vest_4.name: Surfboard Vest
item.vest_4.desc: Vest, Lv.4. Half a surfboard and a lot of tape. Soaks up the most body hits and blasts.
item.helmet_1.name: Sand Pail Helmet
item.helmet_1.desc: Helmet, Lv.1. A kid's sand pail. Takes the edge off headshots.
item.helmet_2.name: Coconut Helmet
item.helmet_2.desc: Helmet, Lv.2. Half a coconut, fully committed. Blocks more headshot damage.
item.helmet_3.name: Diving Helmet
item.helmet_3.desc: Helmet, Lv.3. Brass, clanky and very hard to crack. Blocks even more headshot damage.
item.helmet_4.name: Ship's Bell Helmet
item.helmet_4.desc: Helmet, Lv.4. The wreck's brass bell, worn upside down. Rings loudly, cracks rarely. Blocks the most headshot damage.
item.grenade.name: Pineapple Grenade
item.grenade.desc: Grenade. Hold to cook, release to throw. Goes off with a fruity bang.
item.smoke.name: Candyfloss Smoke Bomb
item.smoke.desc: Smoke bomb. Throw it to puff out a big, thick cloud. Nobody sees in or out. No damage.
item.knife.name: Shucking Knife
item.knife.desc: Knife. Fast little jabs, short reach. Takes your fists' place.
item.machete.name: Coconut Machete
item.machete.desc: Machete. Steady, solid swings. Takes your fists' place.
item.paddle.name: Lifeboat Paddle
item.paddle.desc: Paddle. Slow, heavy swings with long reach. Knocks castaways back a step. Takes your fists' place.
item.dbshotgun.name: Double Scoop Shotgun
item.dbshotgun.desc: Shotgun, double barrel. Two shells, two huge scoops up close. Slow to reload. Uses Seashells.
item.revolver.name: Sand Dollar Revolver
item.revolver.desc: Revolver. Six heavy rounds and a big kick. Uses Coral.
item.rpg.name: Sunburst Launcher
item.rpg.desc: Rocket launcher. One rocket, one very big bang, then a slow reload. Uses Fireworks.
item.ammo_rocket.name: Fireworks
item.ammo_rocket.desc: Rockets for the Sunburst Launcher. Leftovers from the farewell gala. Scarce, so make each one count.
item.scope_red_dot.name: Cherry Red Dot
item.scope_red_dot.desc: Red dot. A bright dot on your sights, like a cherry on top. Quick to aim, a touch of zoom.
item.scope_2x.name: Sea Glass 2x Scope
item.scope_2x.desc: Scope, 2x. A polished sea-glass lens. A little zoom for mid-range fights.
item.scope_4x.name: Spyglass 4x Scope
item.scope_4x.desc: Scope, 4x. Borrowed from the dinner show's pirate captain. Long looks, slower aim.
item.scope_8x.name: Stargazer 8x Scope
item.scope_8x.desc: Scope, 8x. From the ship's stargazing deck. Sees very far, aims very slowly.

level.2.name: Warm
level.3.name: Hot
level.4.name: Scorcher

map.island01.name: Mangomoon Isle
map.island01.tagline: Sun, sand and one seaplane seat.
map.office.name: The Open Plan
map.office.tagline: Desks the size of cliffs. Mind the stapler.
look.island01.morning.line: Dew on the palms. Nobody's awake yet.
look.island01.noon.line: Sun straight overhead. Shade is a luxury.
look.island01.golden.line: Long shadows and a sky like fruit punch.
look.island01.overcast.line: Grey clouds, flat light, grumpy gulls.
look.office.day.line: Every panel on. Nowhere to hide but under a desk.
look.office.evening.line: Sunset through the blinds. Someone left the kettle on.
look.office.afterHours.line: Most lights are off. The desk lamps know your secrets.
